segments.ja21:1.1: Ñātametaṃ kuruṅgassa, yaṃ tvaṃ sepaṇṇi siyyasi [seyyasi (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja21:1.3: Aññaṃ sepaṇṇi gacchāmi, na me te ruccate phalanti.

lines: Yaṃ tvaṃ sepaṇṇi seyyasīti yaṃ tvaṃ ambho sepaṇṇirukkha purato phalāni pātayamāno seyyasi viseyyasi visiṇṇaphalo hosi, taṃ sabbaṃ kuruṅgamigassa pākaṭaṃ jātaṃ.
Na me te ruccate phalanti evaṃ phalaṃ dadamānāya na me tava phalaṃ ruccati, tiṭṭha tvaṃ, ahaṃ aññattha gacchissāmīti agamāsi.
